outcome: proliferation of amniotic mesenchymal stem cells (AMSCs)
gene expression of inflammatory markers in AMSCs
gene expression of MCP-1 in macrophages
cohort: Pregnant patients scheduled for cesarean section, with either GDM or normal glucose tolerance
finding: GDM-derived AMSCs displayed impaired proliferation and osteogenic potential, along with increased invasive and chemotactic capacity, and upregulated inflammatory gene expression compared to control cells, suggesting that the GDM environment may program stem cells and contribute to metabolic dysfunction in offspring.
